message.content:
Right answer: percent = part mass per all mass times 100.

In chem, percent tells a share in a part. Mass each element per mass all elements times 100 gives its %. In a chem case, add part mass per part, then take the same percent step. If a part mass is 2 and all mass is 10, percent = 2 per 10 times 100 = 20. If 5 parts, each part gets its %. All part % make 100. This helps NMDCAT MCQ.

1 read data.
2 pick a part.
3 get its mass.
4 get all mass.
5 divide part mass per all mass.
6 times 100.
7 add %.
8 check: all part % make 100.
